title: DOCTYPE and ENTITY refusal vectors
method: Hand-derived from the pinned source rules named in provenance; no F1 hydrate, project or serializer output was observed or used.

vectors.derivation: A bare DOCTYPE is refused at the boundary before any native construction; no DTD processing, entity expansion or external resolution takes place.
provenance: plan rev d: DTD/ENTITY refusal before native construction and named diagnostic codes

input.text:
<!DOCTYPE bpmn:definitions [ <!ENTITY greeting "hello"> ]>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Defs_Expect" targetNamespace="urn:example:f1-expect"><bpmn:process id="Proc_Expect" isExecutable="false">
<bpmn:task id="Task_Expect" name="&greeting;"/></bpmn:process></bpmn:definitions>

vectors.derivation: Design default (document-level priority): when a DOCTYPE is present its refusal is reported; the nested ENTITY does not change the code. The standalone vectors below isolate the entity code.
provenance: plan rev d: DTD/ENTITY refusal before native construction and named diagnostic codes

vectors.derivation: Standalone ENTITY declaration with no DOCTYPE: isolates xml-entity-declaration-forbidden. The boundary refuses before native construction even though the prologue is not a well-formed document.
provenance: plan rev d: DTD/ENTITY refusal before native construction and named diagnostic codes

vectors.derivation: External entity declarations are refused with the same code; the named resource is never fetched or resolved.
provenance: plan rev d: DTD/ENTITY refusal before native construction and named diagnostic codes

input.text:
<!DOCTYPE bpmn:definitions [ <!ENTITY a "0123456789"> <!ENTITY b "&a;&a;&a;&a;&a;"> <!ENTITY c "&b;&b;&b;&b;&b;"> ]>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Defs_Expect" targetNamespace="urn:example:f1-expect"><bpmn:process id="Proc_Expect" isExecutable="false"/></bpmn:definitions>

vectors.derivation: Nested entity expansion (amplification shape) is stopped by the DOCTYPE refusal; no expansion is performed and no expanded text reaches the tree.
provenance: plan rev d: DTD/ENTITY refusal before native construction and named diagnostic codes
